content.text: Done! I've fixed INC-219. The issue was that the `localArrival` function in `src/eta/local.ts` was hardcoded to always display arrival times in UTC, regardless of the destination port's local timezone. I changed it to use `port.timezone` instead, so now arrival times display in the correct local time for each port. All tests pass, including validation that the conversion works correctly.
